subject.title: North Orange County Community College District Board, Trustee Area 1

text: Trustee, North Orange County Community College District, Area 1

Proven Leadership – Passionate Supporter of Community Colleges
History Professor.
Doctorate - Educational Leadership.
NOCCCD Board of Trustees, President 2026.
President, Community College League Trustee Board. Chair, Community Colleges Women's Caucus. President-elect, Cypress College Foundation.
Former Accreditation Commissioner

Barbara Dunsheath: Vigilantly protects tax dollars from waste. Community Colleges yield the community $14 for every $1 spent. Maintains balanced budget. Ensures facilities like Cypress College STEM and Veterans’ Buildings enhance student success and serve the community.

Advances academic and vocational needs of our community with superior quality and efficiency. Degrees awarded by Fullerton and Cypress College increased 3.3% last year. Building strong workforce through 5,729 credit and noncredit certificate completers. Advocate for expanding Community College Baccalaureate Degrees, Dual Enrollment, and Promise Program -Free College.

Barbara Dunsheath’s important activities include: Her family (husband Jim, three adult children and our puppy Lally), Sunday school teacher, PTA, Girl/Boy Scouts, Habitat for Humanity, YomHashoah, Sierra Club, Daughters of Charity, OC Animal Allies, Red Cross, League of Women Voters, AAUW, California Historical Society.

I have Bi-partisan support.
Please contact Barbara Dunsheath for issues of concern to you: 562-344-6391 BarbDunsheathTrustee@gmail.com
Visit website: BarbforNorthOrange.com
I humbly request your vote. Thank you, Barbara Dunsheath

text: It's time for a leader who listens. Elect Rama Maline to the NOCCCD Board of Trustees.

The NOCCCD Board has too often ignored the community it serves. I'm running to represent Cypress, Los Alamitos, Stanton, Seal Beach, Garden Grove, Westminster, and Anaheim with a more logical approach that puts students and community first.

For nearly 30 years, I've served California as a state prosecutor, taking on organized crime and fraud, securing more than thirty published legal opinions. That same commitment to accountability and the rule of law will guide my work on the Board.

For nearly 20 years, I've also taught legal courses, mentoring students into the workforce and law school. I know what students need: rigorous instruction, real-world skills, meaningful career opportunities, and a fiscally sound institution.

As Trustee, I'll prioritize student success and workforce readiness at Fullerton College, Cypress College, and North Orange Continuing Education, insist on fiscal responsibility and transparency, and expand career and technical training.

As former Treasurer of my statewide attorneys' association, I grew our reserves from $500,000 to over $6,000,000 — a 1,000% increase — proof I deliver results, answering only to students, faculty, and taxpayers.
I respectfully ask for your vote.
